description:
NinjaTrader 8 is open. Real daily OHLCV data for AAPL and MSFT (Jan 2023 - Dec 2024) is available.

Your task is to configure a comparative chart to analyze these two instruments side-by-side without scale distortion:

1. Open a NEW Chart window.
2. Add 'AAPL' (Daily) and 'MSFT' (Daily) to the chart.
3. Configure the chart so BOTH instruments appear in the SAME panel (overlayed), not in separate sub-panels.
4. Configure the Vertical Axes so that:
   - MSFT is plotted on the LEFT axis.
   - AAPL is plotted on the RIGHT axis.
5. Save the workspace to persist your changes.

Goal: A single chart window with two price scales (Left/Right) allowing fair visual comparison of the trends.
